## What Is DSX

DSX is NVIDIA's overarching brand for AI Factories: it spans hardware, data center
power and cooling infrastructure, and software, everything needed to plan, build, and
run a GPU-accelerated data center. It is organized into a handful of named brands,
each covering part of that scope:

![The DSX portfolio by brand: DSX Sim on top, DSX OS (highlighted, the largest concentration of open-source components) below it, then DSX Exchange (also highlighted), DSX Flex, and DSX MaxLPS.](assets/dsx-stack.svg)

- **DSX OS** is the open-source IaaS/PaaS software that provisions, orchestrates, monitors, and serves inference across a cluster: cluster orchestration, infrastructure management, monitoring, resiliency, security, scheduling, workload management, and optimized inference.
- **DSX Exchange** is IT/OT infrastructure communication: the event bus and agent gateway that connect DSX clusters to building management and grid systems.
- **DSX Flex** and **DSX MaxLPS** cover power: grid integration, cooling efficiency, and dynamic power orchestration.
- **DSX Sim** models the other four, so an AI factory can be validated before it is built.

Some of DSX is open source, alongside domains such as hardware and facilities that are
not released as source code by their nature. DSX OS and DSX Exchange are where the
open-source components are concentrated: as of this page's last render, DSX OS
accounts for 47 open-source components and DSX Exchange
1, which is why they are highlighted above. DSX Flex and
DSX MaxLPS do not have open-source components in this index yet. The full list, each
shown against the DSX layer it occupies, is below.

## DSX Components Released as Open Source, by Layer

### ![Cluster Orchestration and Provisioning icon](assets/icons/cluster-orchestration-and-provisioning.svg) Cluster Orchestration and Provisioning

- **[NiCo](https://github.com/dsx-ai-factory/infra-controller)**: Hardware lifecycle management and multitenant networking. Includes the REST API; the separate NVIDIA/infra-controller-rest repo is archived and superseded by this repo's own rest-api directory. (Apache-2.0, open source, dsx-ai-factory)
- **[AICR (AI Cluster Runtime)](https://github.com/NVIDIA/aicr)**: Tooling for optimized, validated, and reproducible GPU-accelerated AI runtime in Kubernetes. (Apache-2.0, open source, NVIDIA org)
- **[DPF (DOCA Platform Framework)](https://github.com/NVIDIA/doca-platform)**: Manages provisioning and service orchestration for BlueField DPUs. (Apache-2.0, open source, NVIDIA org)
- **[Topograph](https://github.com/NVIDIA/topograph)**: Toolkit for discovering cluster network topology. Topology input to KAI Scheduler. (unknown, open source, NVIDIA org)
- **[FARM](https://github.com/NVIDIA/farm)**: Job scheduler for cloud-based workloads. Archived. (Apache-2.0, archived, NVIDIA org)
- **[Nodewright](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nodewright)**: Kubernetes Operator to manage node OS customizations. (Apache-2.0, open source, NVIDIA org)
- **[GPU Operator](https://github.com/NVIDIA/gpu-operator)**: Creates, configures, and manages GPUs in Kubernetes. (Apache-2.0, open source, NVIDIA org)
- **[NVIDIA Network Operator](https://github.com/Mellanox/network-operator)**: Creates, configures, and manages NIC drivers, RDMA, and network resources in Kubernetes. Networking counterpart to GPU Operator. (Apache-2.0, open source, Mellanox org)
- **[NKE (NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine)](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nke)**: Management plane for GPU Kubernetes on bare metal. (Apache-2.0, INTERNAL, TO BE RELEASED)
- **[DSX OS Maestro](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Maestro)**: Scripted workflow engine used for datacenter automation, including cluster bring-up, maintenance, and break/fix. (Apache-2.0, INTERNAL, TO BE RELEASED)
- **[DRA Driver for NVIDIA GPUs](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/dra-driver-nvidia-gpu)**: Dynamic Resource Allocation driver for NVIDIA GPUs on Kubernetes, donated to kubernetes-sigs. (Apache-2.0, foundation-governed (Kubernetes SIGs / CNCF))

### ![Scheduling and Workload Management icon](assets/icons/scheduling-and-workload-management.svg) Scheduling and Workload Management

- **[Run:ai](https://github.com/dsx-ai-factory/run-ai)**: Run:ai AI workload orchestration platform for Kubernetes, the core control plane. No public core Run:ai repo exists yet; the run-ai org's public repos (Run:ai Model Streamer, Karta) are separate sub-tools, not this platform itself.
